research_intent: Preserve broad TOPIX participation while using a small sector-momentum overlay and absolute-trend gating to improve drawdown and risk-adjusted return. Historical alpha versus 1306 is not treated as proven.

data.series: official NEXT FUNDS distribution-reinvested NAV per share

relative_momentum.relative_benchmark: equal-weight synthetic return of the 17 TOPIX-17 official NAV series

rebalance.signal_date_rule: last official NAV observation of a completed calendar month
rebalance.execution_date_rule: first official NAV observation strictly after the signal date

historical_reference.note: Historical results were used to select this model and are not a pristine confirmatory test. Prospective results after the freeze date are the primary evidence going forward.

change_control.rule: Do not edit parameters in this model ID. Any parameter, universe, data-source, signal, gate, rebalance, or portfolio-weight change must create a new model_id/version and preserve this file unchanged.
